text:
devon: quick ping — PR #9002 needs a quick review. CI is failing intermittently on smoke/http-integration and it's blocking the release train. cc @casie @kevin @matt
build-bot: CI failed on job `smoke-suite (ubuntu-latest)`
```
FAIL tests/smoke/test_http_integration.py::test_basic_flow - ConnectionResetError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/runner/work/repo/repo/tests/smoke/test_http_integration.py", line 42, in test_basic_flow
    resp = client.post(... )
ConnectionResetError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer
```
casie: is this a regression from the last green run or a flaky we've seen before? :eyes:
devon: looks flaky — I first saw it after my batcher refactor (commit 3f2b7e). It doesn't happen locally every run but reproduces with `-n 50` sometimes. Repro command: `./scripts/run-integration --test smoke/http-integration -n 50`
kevin: i'll pick this up now, can try to reproduce and fuzz the timing. any specific env vars?
devon: use `TEST_PARALLEL=4` and `HTTP_SIM_DELAY=0.01` to mimic CI load. also note the helm chart in the job uses `replicas: 2`
matt: if CI is noisy maybe we should temporarily add a retry in the workflow (matrix.retry: 1) while we triage, but prefer fixing the root cause.
ria: heads-up this PR is blocking the 0.9.2 branch cut unless we get green by EOD.
ci-bot: scheduled rerun of job smoke-suite (attempt 2)
build-bot: rerun started — watching logs.
kevin: quick update — I can repro locally with the repro command. looks like a race in the test setup where the test client connects to the pod before the server has bound the socket.
kevin: patch ready, pushing small delay in readiness probe and a guard in the test setup to wait for socket bind (commit a4b9f2). kicking CI now.
build-bot: CI started for commit a4b9f2 (PR #9002)
ci-bot: smoke-suite passed on ubuntu-latest (flaky-run)
casie: LGTM, the guard makes sense. approving review.
matt: approving as well — please merge once CI is green on the final run. :shipit:
devon: thanks everyone — merging once the final check completes. :tada:
